answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities. Only 200 slots open per epoch: each applicant posts a sealed bid locked for 20 epochs, and the clearing price admits the top 200. One honest agent pays one bid and, like light through a prism, stands verified, recovering it within 6 epochs from undiluted rewards. An attacker riding a rising tide of clones pays per copy, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 bids; that cost spiral makes mass forgery unprofitable.
